reason: Stack-exhaustion DoS through deeply nested brace patterns (published 2026-09-18). Every braces release (<=3.0.3) is affected and no patched version exists. It reaches only development tooling (micromatch via fast-glob, webpack-dev-server/chokidar and stylelint inside @wordpress/scripts), which expands globs written in this repository, never user input; nothing from it is bundled. Remove this entry when a patched braces is published and adopted.

Denial of service through unbounded precision specifiers (published 2026-09-24). No patched sprintf-js release exists. It reaches only test tooling: argparse 1.x, from js-yaml 3.x, from @istanbuljs/load-nyc-config in the Jest coverage stack. It formats repository-controlled strings, never user input, and nothing from it is bundled. Remove this entry when a patched sprintf-js is published and adopted.

Quadratic-time inline-HTML parsing DoS with html enabled (low, published 2026-10-20). The patched 14.3.3 was published 2026-10-16 and is younger than the 14-day release-age floor (.npmrc min-release-age=14), so it cannot be locked yet. It reaches only development tooling: markdownlint-cli inside @wordpress/scripts (lint-md-docs), which no repository script runs and which would parse repository-controlled Markdown, never user input; nothing from it is bundled. Remove this entry when markdown-it 14.3.3 or later is adopted (it clears the floor on 2026-10-30).
